name: joshboyer-ca
description: Josh Boyer's imported portfolio and preserved career knowledge

scripts.check:chat-cloud: npm --prefix services/chat run check && npm --prefix services/edge run check && npm --prefix infra/aws run check
scripts.test:chat-cloud: npm --prefix services/chat test && npm --prefix services/edge test && npm --prefix infra/aws test
scripts.build:chat-cloud: npm --prefix services/chat run build && npm --prefix services/edge run build && npm --prefix infra/aws run synth -- --profile joshboyer-portfolio
scripts.build: npm run check && npm run check:security && npm run check:chat-knowledge && node tools/build-manifest.cjs
